exposure: hospital birth attended by certified nurse midwives
outcome: not low risk according to ACOG and AAP criteria
cohort: The study cohort consisted of midwife-attended planned home births and certified nurse midwife-attended hospital births in the United States from 2010 through 2012, identified from birth certificate data.
finding: At least 30% of midwife-attended planned home births in the United States from 2010-2012 were not low risk and did not meet clinical criteria set by ACOG and AAP.
